headline: Qualcomm Fourth-Quarter Smartphone Chip Sales Fall 26%
summary: Qualcomm shares fell after reporting that fourth-quarter revenue from its handset unit, which produces smartphone chips, dropped 26% to $5.14 billion, missing estimates.
why: Semiconductor manufacturers dependent on mobile handset markets are sensitive to cyclical shifts in smartphone demand and customer inventory adjustments.

impacts.name: Qualcomm Inc.
impacts.why: Qualcomm's handset revenue dropped 26%, causing shares to fall.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Qualcomm shares fell after reporting a 26% decline in fourth-quarter smartphone chip revenue, missing analyst estimates.
